chunks: And Allah seeks from you the thanksgiving due to Him, and assigns to you His affairs,
He grants you respite in a limited field, so that you may vie with each other for precedence (in reward).
Therefore, tighten the knots of your girdles, and fold up the excess of your loincloths,
And high resolve and feasting do not go together,
And sleep causes weakness in the major affairs of the day,
It obliterates the darkness from the remembrance of the spirits (or: it clears the darkness for the recollection of the resolve)!
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean by tightening the girdles and avoiding feasting in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs vivid metaphors of a racecourse and a limited arena to emphasize the urgency of *Jihad al-Nafs* (struggle against the self) amidst the transient nature of worldly life. This passage reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing asceticism with active engagement, urging believers to curb excesses in food and sleep to maintain spiritual alertness for the ultimate accountability before God.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Allāh seeks you to thank Him and assigns to you His affairs.
He has allowed time in the limited field (of life) so that you may vie with each other in seeking the reward (of Paradise).
Therefore, tight up your girdles and wrap up the skirts.
High courage and dinners do not go together.
Sleep causes weakness in the big affairs of the day
and (its) darkness obliterates the memories of courage.
